matched_source_rows: *45:- Full-chain verification MUST consume the exact file/root/order sequence parsed from `apply.sh`; a second hand-maintained active list is not an oracle.

raw_tool_output.text:
[.trellis/spec/backend/patch-rollup-contracts.md#D845]
 44:- Finalized old patches MUST remain byte-identical in a retired directory with pinned hashes.
*45:- Full-chain verification MUST consume the exact file/root/order sequence parsed from `apply.sh`; a second hand-maintained active list is not an oracle.
 46:- Runtime source bytes MUST remain unchanged when switching from the old effective chain to the rollup chain. This equivalence is discharged per family on the family-generation baseline (old member chain vs rollup, byte-compared) — no single baseline can host both the retired member shapes and the current chain, so a whole-chain old-vs-new oracle is not required and MUST NOT be faked by pointing both sides at the same resolved plan.
 47:- Identical OLDCHAIN/resolved plans MUST be materialized only once. A NOTE is not
 48:  equivalence evidence. When representations differ, OLDCHAIN must name retained
